snake_tube_top.description: A large serpentine or tubular form — possibly a pipe, snake, or cosmological channel — entering from the top center of the folio. It has a scaly/segmented texture and descends vertically through the center of the composition, bisecting text lines as it passes through. A blue dot or ball is visible at the very top terminus. This element is the primary bisecting anchor for lines f75v.1 through f75v.17.

snake_tube_tail.description: The lower curling tail of the serpentine form, exiting the bottom of the folio in a curved arc toward the right. It extends below the lower nymph basin and creates the lower anchor for the @Pb and tail end of the composition.

nymph_basin_upper.description: The main large upper illustration zone — a curved bath or pool structure with a scalloped decorative border along its top edge. Inside, a row of female nymph figures stand or recline, with label tablets (label_tablets_upper) above them. Colored with green/blue washes. This is the primary illustration of the folio.

nymph_figures_upper.description: Approximately 10–12 female nymph figures depicted in profile or frontal view, standing in the upper basin. Each figure has a label above it (@Ln). The figures are evenly spaced across the width of the basin.

label_tablets_upper.description: Rectangular tablet-like areas above each nymph figure containing the @Ln label text. These are small boxes approximately 50–70 normalized units wide and 30–40 units tall, arranged in a row across the upper basin.

scalloped_border_top.description: A wavy/scalloped decorative border forming the top edge of the upper nymph basin. The scallops are organic, blob-like forms arranged in a continuous wave. The border spans the full width of the basin.

nymph_basin_lower.description: A smaller rounded tub or pool in the lower portion of the folio, containing a second cluster of nymph figures. This pool has an organic, bean-shaped outline with blue water wash inside. The @Lt label group (f75v.50–56) is associated with this structure.

nymph_figures_lower.description: A smaller cluster of female nymph figures within the lower basin/pool. Fewer in number than the upper group (approximately 6–8 figures). Some appear to be seated or partially submerged.

isolated_zones.status: Intentionally bisected — primary structural bisector for 17 text lines
isolated_zones.description: The snake_tube_top is the single most significant visual anchor on this folio for text layout purposes. It causes <-> bisection in all 17 lines of f75v.1–17, creating two independent text columns flanking the tube descending from the top edge. The tube itself is completely text-free — no inscription is written on or across its body. The single-character @L0 labels beside it (s, l, l, o, r, s) are the only text touching its immediate vicinity.

isolated_zones.status: Completely text-free interior — text surrounds it above and below
isolated_zones.description: The interior of the upper nymph basin contains only the nymph figures and label tablets. The main @P0 paragraph text runs above it (lines 1–17, bisected) and below it (lines 38–49). The basin's interior figure area is a text-free illustrated zone.

isolated_zones.status: Encircled by @Ln labels above — figures themselves text-free
isolated_zones.description: Each nymph figure body is text-free. The @Ln labels are confined to the label_tablets_upper zone directly above each figure. The figures' bodies, arms, and lower torsos have no text overlay.

The lower nymph basin interior is text-free. The @Lt labels (f75v.50–56) are positioned to its right side. The @P0 main paragraph text wraps around its left and lower sides but does not enter the basin.
The curling tail of the serpentine form at the bottom of the folio is a text-free drawn element. No text is inscribed on or directly adjacent to the tail.
